functions.spark_sql: SELECT id, i / CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN 0 ELSE p END AS DOUBLE) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id, i / CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN '-0.0' ELSE CAST(p AS STRING) END AS DOUBLE) AS result
FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id, i / CAST(CASE id WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN NULL ELSE p END AS DOUBLE) AS result
FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id, i / CAST(CASE id WHEN 1 THEN 'NaN' WHEN 2 THEN 'Infinity'
                                                  WHEN 3 THEN '-Infinity' ELSE CAST(p AS STRING) END AS DOUBLE) AS result
FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) / CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN 0 ELSE p END AS DOUBLE) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, i / CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id, CAST(i AS FLOAT) % CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN '-0.0' ELSE CAST(p AS STRING) END AS FLOAT) AS result
FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id, CAST(i AS DOUBLE) % CAST(CASE id WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN NULL ELSE p END AS DOUBLE) AS result
FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, i / CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 0
